clusters.name: FoundationSDK create/release/allocator/errors
clusters.notes: PATCH: Task 5 adapted the three c_sdk-owned allocations to the immutable 2.1.2 function-like NX_NEW(type) macro. Task 7 differential RED found oracle/rebuild FoundationSDK allocation sizes 56/76 bytes. Oracle NxCreateFoundationSDK RVA 0x00004020 pushes 0x38; constructor/destructor/error/event slices in dumps/oracle_sdk_capstone.txt recover interface offset +0x14, debug-array storage +0x1c..+0x24, first/last errors +0x2c/+0x30, and lifecycle byte +0x34. The private currentID/freeIDs storage and getNewID/freeID methods had no call sites and no oracle exports; removing them and reordering remaining private fields restores 56 bytes. dumps/sdk_vtable_compare.txt proves matching one-entry Observable, one-entry FoundationSDK Observable-base, and ordered ten-entry NxFoundationSDK-interface tables. Separate-process oracle/rebuild runtime output is identical for exact/wrong version, create/release/recreate, allocator/global binding, stream replacement, short warning callback, and error clearing (dumps/sdk_differential_red.txt and sdk_differential_green.txt). DefaultAllocator.* required no Task 7 change. Scope excludes assertions, long-message realloc, allocator failure, live-observer deferral, copying, concurrency, profiler/debug behavior, and exhaustive errors; global structural/selected_behavior gates remain pending for Task 8.

clusters.name: Exception
clusters.notes: KEEP: Capstone x86-32 shows a 16-byte object with vftable at +0 and error/file/line at +4/+8/+0xc. Exported vftable RVA 0x0001c210 contains the three getter RVAs 0x00002d80/0x00002d90/0x00002da0 in that order followed by zero. Constructor RVA 0x00002e00, copy constructor RVA 0x00002db0, and assignment RVA 0x00002de0 write/copy exactly those fields. The public-ABI loader resolves every assigned export and obtains identical oracle/rebuild results for construction, all getters, copy, assignment, return-this semantics, 16-byte bytes, and vtable identity/order (dumps/exception_differential.txt). No production change was needed. Proof excludes invalid object pointers and lifetime of caller-owned file strings.

clusters.name: Observable
clusters.notes: KEEP: Capstone x86-32 identifies a 16-byte Observable with one-slot event vftable at +0 and the observer pointer array begin/end/capacity at +4/+8/+0xc. Constructor RVA 0x00003cf0 zeroes those fields; destructor RVA 0x00003d10 frees owned storage; copy/assignment RVAs 0x00003d40/0x00003d60 call deep array operations. Event RVA 0x000042e0 is a no-op ret 8 and count RVA 0x000043d0 computes (+8 - +4)/4. The public-ABI loader resolves all ten assigned exports and produces identical oracle/rebuild results for add/remove/count, ordered notify callbacks, removed-observer suppression, last-observer event 2, deep copy/assignment ownership, destruction, and the exported one-slot vtable (dumps/observable_differential.txt). No production change was needed. Unsupported cases include duplicate observers, missing-observer assertion policy, mutation during notification, self-deletion, allocation failure, and concurrency.

clusters.name: NxProfiler / DefineZone
clusters.notes: KEEP: every one of the 49 assigned code/data exports has a PE+Capstone attachment in dumps/oracle_pe_capstone.json and is required by the loader gate. createProfilingZone RVA 0x00002f70 requests 0x38 bytes. Named/default constructors are at 0x00004a60/0x00005170; copy/assignment at 0x00003390/0x000033f0 copy semantic fields +4/+8 and +0x10..+0x30 while leaving padding; destructor 0x000046a0 removes/reindexes the zone. Public NxProfilingZone defines the three semantic vftable slots release/enter/leave at RVA 0x0001c288; later executable pointers before the next export are adjacent data, not claimed slots. Separate-process oracle/rebuild output matches for initialization/global dimensions, named/default/copy/assignment, zone list/index/name, direct and scoped enter/leave, release, ticks, stdev, sort, mode, and normalized update invariants (dumps/profiler_differential.txt). No production change. Timing magnitudes, long-run smoothing/statistical accuracy, recursion/overflow, concurrent zones, allocation failure, and abnormal scope exit are outside this selected gate.

clusters.name: Time
clusters.notes: KEEP: all six exports are resolved and exercised. Capstone RVAs 0x00005190/0x000051b0 call and convert QueryPerformanceCounter/Frequency; 0x000051f0 subtracts and replaces the 8-byte epoch before division; 0x00005250 computes without replacing; constructor 0x000052a0 seeds via GetElapsedSeconds; assignment 0x00004670 copies exactly 8 bytes. Separate-process oracle/rebuild output matches for positive stable frequency, monotonic ticks, non-resetting peek, elapsed reset, exact epoch assignment, and documented scheduler-tolerant bounds (dumps/time_differential.txt). No production change. Exact tick/frequency values and cross-process elapsed magnitudes are nondeterministic and deliberately not compared; suspend/resume, counter failure, clock migration, and long-duration precision are outside this gate.

clusters.name: FPU control exports
clusters.notes: PATCH: all eleven exports are resolved. Capstone RVAs 0x000040d0..0x00004180 show the legacy CRT control-helper calls/masks; conversion bodies begin at 0x000041c0/0x00004200/0x00004270. Separate-process state measurement found the oracle changes only x87 and leaves MXCSR byte-exact unchanged, while the rebuilt modern _controlfp also changed SSE rounding/masks. RED: oracle exit 0, rebuild exit 1 at rounding-chop MXCSR. The minimal Win32 patch uses fnstcw/fldcw masked updates for precision (0x0300), rounding (0x0c00), and exceptions (0x003f; true=0x003f, false=0x0002 denormal-only masked). GREEN matches oracle for every setter, exact restoration, and seven finite NxInt conversion vectors (dumps/fpu_differential.txt). NaN/infinity, out-of-range conversion shifts, pending x87 exception delivery, and multithreaded FPU-state interactions are outside this gate.

clusters.name: Box helpers
clusters.notes: KEEP: all 13 exports have PE+Capstone attachments. All six plane normal/d rows, eight point rows, and eight vertex-normal rows are hard-checked and bit-serialized in order; oracle/rebuild output is exact. The old sampled predicate false-passes a deliberately wrong formerly unchecked point[1], while the strengthened oracle gate rejects it. Edges/axes/quads/triangles and all eight NxBoxVertexToQuad rows 345/045/015/135/234/024/012/123 are exact. Identity world/local edge normal and inside/touching/outside/reverse containment also match (dumps/box_differential.txt). Float/vector hard assertions use 1e-4 while serialized differential values are exact. No production change. Invalid indexes, NaN/infinity, negative extents, and non-orthonormal rotations are excluded.

clusters.name: Capsule helpers
clusters.notes: KEEP: Capstone attachments cover NxComputeBoxAroundCapsule RVA 0x00008c10 and NxComputeCapsuleAroundBox RVA 0x00008380. For X/Y/Z capsule axes, center/extents and every bit of all three 3x3 orientation rows are emitted and compared exactly; all row/column norms and pairwise dots plus determinant handedness are hard-checked. Flipping both formerly unchecked secondary rows preserves the old row0+det predicate but is rejected by the strengthened exact gate. Box-to-capsule largest X/Y/Z, equal-axis tie, translated center, and zero extents/radius remain checked (dumps/capsule_differential.txt). No production change. Zero-length input capsules, negative radius/extents, non-orthonormal box rotations, NaN/infinity, and aliasing are excluded.

clusters.name: Sphere helpers
clusters.notes: KEEP: Capstone covers NxComputeSphere RVA 0x0000a420, NxFastComputeSphere RVA 0x00009020, and NxMergeSpheres RVA 0x0000a540. Separate-process oracle/rebuild output matches for null/empty, single, pair, and multi-point enclosing behavior; the robust method's measured GEMS selection; and disjoint, containment both orders, coincident, touching, and first-output-alias merges (dumps/sphere_differential.txt). No production change. NxComputeSphere's observed GEMS selection is recorded without claiming the unreachable/buggy miniball branch; four-point miniball assertion paths, aliasing the second merge input, negative radii, NaN/infinity, and very large coordinates are excluded.

clusters.name: Ray/Segment distance
clusters.notes: KEEP: Capstone covers NxComputeDistanceSquared RVA 0x00008d50 and NxComputeSquareDistance RVA 0x00008df0. Separate-process oracle/rebuild output matches valid normalized-ray interior projection, origin clamping, an on-ray point, null output, and output aliasing; and segment interior, both endpoint clamps, zero length, and output aliasing (dumps/ray_seg_differential.txt). No production change. Non-unit and zero directions are both excluded consistently because immutable NxRay.h explicitly requires a normalized direction; the preliminary differing non-unit characterization is non-authoritative and neither invalid case is claimed as parity coverage.

clusters.name: Volume integrals
clusters.notes: KEEP: Capstone covers NxComputeVolumeIntegrals RVA 0x00007220; VolumeIntegration.cpp is unchanged since the imported source baseline. Separate-process oracle/rebuild gates match analytic tetrahedron mass, COM, origin inertia, and COM inertia for 32-bit indices, translation/density scaling, 16-bit indices plus flipped normals, and the null-allocator false/unchanged-output guard (dumps/volume_differential.txt). A 1e-4 absolute tensor tolerance is required for modern-compiler normalization/cancellation drift on the translated mesh; the largest observed rebuilt analytic error was about 4.2e-5. Degenerate/open/self-intersecting meshes and invalid indexes are excluded.

clusters.name: Bounds/CRC/tangents/inertia helpers
clusters.notes: PATCH: all five exports have Capstone attachments at RVAs 0x000053f0, 0x00006230, 0x00005e40, 0x00005f20, and 0x000062b0 and are resolved/exercised. RED: oracle mapped unit X to unit Y while rebuild NxFindRotationMatrix mapped it to negative Y. Public NxMat33 multiplication and matrix dumps traced this to reversed cross orientation; the minimal patch changes v.cross(from,to) to v.cross(to,from). GREEN matches across general/parallel/antiparallel rotation, deep CRC vectors, empty/extrema bounds, both tangent branches, and diagonal/symmetric inertia invariants (dumps/util_differential.txt). User-authorized git apply preserved the 7651-byte non-UTF8 file: only offsets 5248..5255 changed and legacy 0xF6 stayed at 4956. Degenerate non-unit rotation inputs, zero normal tangents, NaN/infinity, Jacobi nonconvergence, and aliasing beyond documented output/input separation are not claimed.

clusters.name: DebugRenderable
clusters.notes: PATCH: SDK create/release/render exports remain attached at RVAs 0x00003f10, 0x00003bd0, and 0x000034c0. The 52-byte object, 15 executable interface slots, allocator/buffer retention, SDK append/render/release ownership, and null release are measured. Every point/line/triangle record from low-level primitives and selected AABB/frame, OBB, arrow, basis, full-circle, and semicircle calls is bit-serialized with color in insertion order; stable low-level and all 15 AABB/frame records are hard-checked. A deliberately wrong line endpoint proves the former color-only predicate false-passed. The strengthened differential found five circle records differing by 1-2 ULP/near-zero bits. Runtime vtable slot 14 localized oracle addCircle at RVA 0x00001930; Capstone shows extended x87 fild/fmul/fsin/fcos with a float-rounded second angle. The minimal private Win32 x87 patch reproduces that order and makes all 59 generated lines exact (dumps/debug_differential.txt and debug_circle_capstone.txt).
